phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Kuuɗe nokkuure seɗɗa, laar haalaji kujewol bee ardiiɗo ma. Limle telefoŋ'en ɓe hollaayi.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Jaɓɓorgo Kewuuji jaɓɓorgo plus taskaram jaɓɓorgo wuro. Groundwork hokkata jaɓɓorgo wuro be hawtaaki be jaɓɓortooɓe. Ngam wallugo ha nder lesdi, nodde 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Njaayol jaayngol, walaa ceede je ɗon tabiti.

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: On mbaawi bo tappugo Needi ballal jonta ha fuɗɗam kuje fuu.

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Wurtin nyalnde kiita fuu be jaɓɓitol ha nder kalandar

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Laar ceede, ceede e ceede je on hokkata

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Wondugo nder Medicaid, e SNAP to a yiɗi

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Wurtin nokkuure jam ngam jooɗugo (wurtin 211 mala kujeji jooɗorde ha nokkuure man)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Wurtinugo nyamndu ngam asaweere ndu (wurtinugo 211 mala suudu nyaamdu ha nokkuure man)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Jaɓɓorgo Ganndal  ⁇  ngam lartol. Ɗaɓɓol arandewol ngam wakkatiiji 24 arandejum ɓaawo jaɓɓol wurtoto ɗo to on jaɓɓake.

safety.vaultHelp.en: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.vaultHelp.draft: Dookimenji ma ɗon winda. Furniture je ɓe yoɓata; walaa ceede je ɓe tabitini.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Naa' a go'oto. Haɓɓugo mala windi do 988, mala 911 ha nder nyau.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
work.paroleNote.draft: Lartine haalaji je on wurtinaama mala je on wurtinaama e ardiiɗo on hiddeko on wurtina.
